script_text: Stop! Pisces, the Moon is turning toward your 8th House with an intense trine today, amplifying your intuitive nature and deep inner reflection. Venus forms a beautiful sextile to your ruling Moon in the 9th House of Higher Learning, bringing creative inspiration but also heightened emotional sensitivity that could surface unexpectedly. As a Water sign, you'll feel deeply connected tonight—expect meaningful conversations that reveal hidden truths about your partner and strengthen your bond. Your 7th House of partnerships receives supportive Mars energy through a square to your 10th House, urging you to set clear boundaries in work relationships before they become overwhelming. Avoid overcommitting emotionally; the water in your chart suggests you may absorb others' stress without establishing healthy limits. Follow for tomorrow's reading to see how Saturn will shape your next steps.
